summary: The debrief and the standing fold now call the model through the Agent SDK instead of hand-rolled raw completions.
details: Two of the four call sites that bypassed the SDK are on it, through one seam in nora/agent/structured.py.

They inherit the SDK's machinery instead of each carrying a different subset of it, and the instruction now goes in the system role with the transcript in the user role rather than both concatenated into one user message.
The relevance gate moved with them and has since moved back, on a measurement — see the note about the admission decision and the forged transcript row. The system/user split it gained here is kept.
